correctness.rationale: A maximal independent set is exactly a cyclic 3/4/5-gap composition; this gives a_n recursion, Z_n=3a_(n-3)+4a_(n-4)+5a_(n-5), and ordered one-site and two-site counts a_n and a_d a_(n-d), hence the stated circulant spectrum. At nonzero Fourier frequency, covariance is a nonnegative squared Fourier coefficient average. In every n>=11 a legal replacement (3,5)↔(4,4) changes one chosen vertex, forcing positive frequency; n=8 also allows it. Explicit small odd cycles and n=10 witness positivity; n=6 has three opposite pairs, leaving odd modes null. The constant mode is |S| variance/n and vanishes exactly if the interval ceil(n/5)..floor(n/3) has one integer, which occurs at 5,6,7,8,11. Independent exhaustive bit-mask enumeration and DFT checked all n=5..14; the gap-slide argument, not this finite enumeration, proves n>=12.
